metas.name: 1. Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
metas.description: Homer's Christmas bonus is canceled and the rainy-day funds are needed to pay for Bart's tattoo removal.

metas.name: 2. Bart the Genius
metas.description: Bart's labeled a genius and sent to a school for the gifted.

metas.name: 3. Homer's Odyssey
metas.description: After being fired from the nuclear power plant for negligence, Homer becomes a safety activist.

metas.name: 4. There's No Disgrace Like Home
metas.description: After seeing families being nice to each other at a company picnic, Homer orders the Simpsons to a family therapist.

metas.name: 5. Bart the General
metas.description: Terrorized by the school bully, Bart seeks counsel from Grandpa Simpson, who takes him to a warfare expert for basic training.

metas.name: 6. Moaning Lisa
metas.description: The meaning of life and second grade have Lisa playing the blues solo, until she jams with a kindred spirit; Homer seeks tutelage to beat Bart at video boxing.

metas.name: 7. The Call of the Simpsons
metas.description: The Simpsons put the wild back in the wilderness when their RV goes over a cliff and Homer and Bart go for help, get lost and lose their clothes.

metas.name: 8. The Telltale Head
metas.description: Bart pulls a stunt that shocks the entire town, including the new friends he was trying to impress.

metas.name: 9. Life on the Fast Lane
metas.description: Homer's bowling-ball gift "for Marge" prompts her to take up the sport, and maybe also a handsome instructor who offers to teach her "many things."

metas.name: 10. Homer's Night Out
metas.description: Shutterbug Bart captures Homer with a sexy entertainer at a bachelor party.

metas.name: 11. The Crepes of Wrath
metas.description: A little story about how Bart saves France after blowing up Principal Skinner's mom with a cherry bomb.

metas.name: 12. Krusty Gets Busted
metas.description: Bart's TV hero Krusty the Clown is arrested for a convenience-store robbery, and witness Homer must testify against the clown.

metas.name: 13. Some Enchanted Evening
metas.description: Homer takes Marge out for a romantic night, leaving the kids with a sitter, who's profiled on "America's Most Armed and Dangerous."
